charter: docs/plans/v0.5.13-charter.md at 04402e7a (SHA-256 2832dc4870b0fb094e724a3ff6d6fb6c5710f2da5827791b8fa102c06230c813), step 0, 'The named identity units' (Codex r2, item 3)
trigger: step 0 of Part A, once; the charter authorizes it
purpose: establish protected identity: the payloads that ID-AFTER (step 5) and NR-A1 (step 1) are compared with

units.inputs: tests/baseline_code_v0511.py (the synthetic fixtures of versions 1 to 4), src/ at the approval state
units.environment: the inherited default thread settings (no OMP_NUM_THREADS, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS or MKL_NUM_THREADS set by the unit); processors 8 to 31, BelowNormal (the job object)

units.inputs: every tracked YAML claim (pack and kind keys)
the ten locked tags, in the warm environments under .cache/lock-compat
outputs: the unit's stdout (joint PASS, n of 10) in the journal by its hash

comparison: ID-AFTER (step 5) and NR-A1 (step 1) compare every protected output byte (payload.files_sha256 and payload.error_outputs of the golden record; payload.claims of the claim record) with these, provenance compared separately; verify_locked_tags gives joint PASS 10 of 10. A byte mismatch, missing output or unverified pin stops Part A.
